title: The Strand Theater and Pres burning his part in I Struck a Match
summary: At the Strand, Basie staged a number with Earl Warren singing in the dark and Pres burned his arrangement.

story.theme_name: Band pranks, jokes and gigs gone wrong
story.community_name: Pranks, practical jokes and band humor

blocks.x: What was this joke we were talking about last night, you know, when you were playing, what was the deal, "In the Dark," or something?
"I Struck a Match in the Dark."
Oh, yeah.
We were going into this theater, the Strand. That was our big moment, you know, on Broadway.

Well, that's okay. We'll talk about it tomorrow. Well, you were at the Strand on Broadway?

Broadway. And it was our big chance. So Basie wanted a production number and Earl Warren could sing, you know. And Pres always irritated everybody singing, he would make comedy out of it, regardless of who it was, you know.

So we got this arrangement, I think Jimmy Mundy made this arrangement on "I Struck a Match in the Dark." So the lights would go out and then Earl Warren would start singing and then we would all strike a match in the dark, you know.
You were all sitting in --

We were all sitting on the stage, you know. And we were sharp and everything. So when Earl Warren would sing, "I struck a match in the dark," we were supposed to strike a match, you know, and light up the bandstand. So when he said -- Earl Warren made the introduction, "I struck a match in the dark," Pres held up the arrangement and struck a match and burned up the whole arrangement. Burned his part up.
(Laughter.)
Was that the end of that number?
